prose: USB is an open-source trust layer for AI skills and MCP servers. It finds skills, servers, agents and commands in repositories, compares what they claim to do with observable evidence using a static scanner (secscan) and a live MCP probe (mcprobe), and installs them into 16 runtimes such as Claude Code and Cursor. Version 1.0.8 lists 529 skills and installs with an npm command. The claims are the project's own.
highlights: Checks declared behavior against observed behavior
secscan static scan plus mcprobe live probing
One installer across Claude Code, Cursor and others
